# Md. Tariquzzaman

Academic website: https://mdtariquzzaman.github.io/

Research: Safety; Creativity; Cultural Bias in large language models. I study how cultural context, task framing, and data contamination shape their behavior. I aim to build trustworthy and reliable language models with creative capabilities to solve real-world problems.
